messages:
Kevin: Heads up — thinking about an SLA-aware cost projection widget for Console. Quick brain-dump and a couple questions for the econ + UX folks. 

Maya: love it. do you mean a realtime projection (next 24h) or a queued estimate based on current traffic? :thinking:

Kevin: good q. leaning realtime-ish but with smoothing. goal: show predicted spend under current routing + autoscale policies and highlight risk of breaking an SLA (p95 latency spikes => fallback to higher-cost model). want a single-card view + drilldown.

Aj: two parts we need to decide: (1) sampling resolution (per-minute vs per-5m) and (2) how to represent cache savings impact. minute-level is noisy and expensive to compute for all tenants. 

Linda: for cache impact, we should show both raw token delta and "net cost after cache credits". people care about dollars saved, not just tokens. suggestion: display projected_cost and projected_savings.

Kevin: agree. proposed formula (pseudo):
```js
// per-route projection
projected_cost = sum_over_routes( projected_tokens * unit_price_per_token * (1 - cache_credit_rate) )
projected_savings = sum_over_routes( projected_tokens * unit_price_per_token * cache_credit_rate )

// where projected_tokens uses EWMA on recent per-minute token rate
```

Sam: EWMA is good. need to pick half-life. 15m default? also: when routing fallback happens (e.g., model_x -> model_x_small), unit_price changes and quality changes. do we show two columns: cost and expected quality delta?

Maya: UX thought: keep the card small — primary metric = projected_dollars (24h). attach two toggles: "include cache credits" and "simulate fallback to model variant". toggle triggers a quick re-query.

Aj: backend costs: computing EWMA + cost across all routes every minute for 100k tenants is heavy. alternatives: pre-aggregate per route per tenant at 1m, then materialize 5m rollups. projection query can read rollups + do cheap math. also consider caching projection results for 30s.

Kevin: good. what about SLA risk scoring? idea: show a tiny risk bar: green/yellow/red based on % of requests in last window that hit latency SLO. if >5% breaches, yellow; >15% red. we can simulate impact of routing fallback by showing projected cost delta and projected p95.

Linda: for chargeback accuracy, we must surface assumptions: sample rate, price per token (model SKU), cache-crediting window. show a small "assumptions" link. auditors will ask.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: cost-proj-aggregation-worker v2 -> staging at 2025-08-12T13:00Z (sha: a1b2c3).

Sam: couple edge cases: 1) cold start of cache (first N minutes) inflates projected_cost if cache credit not warmed; 2) routes with bursty traffic skew EWMA. propose a "warmup-aware" mode that discounts initial minutes.

Aj: agree. implementation notes: we should compute two projections: optimistic (assume cache warms) and conservative (assume no warming). show both as min/max shading on chart.

Maya: small copy ask: title = "Projected spend (24h) — SLA risk". tooltip should explain shading and toggles. also add an export link for CSV for finance.

Kevin: next steps: Aj + Sam to prototype server rollup and EWMA params, Maya + Linda to mock UX and copy. I'll own the product spec. plan: ship behind feature flag to 10% of tenants for 2 weeks, compare projected vs realized spend. sound ok? :thumbsup:

Linda: sounds good. tagging finance for sign-off on unit prices before rollout. @Maya please ping @finance.

Kevin: will do. thanks all.
